sprint: Magic Publish — Sprint M7 (Audio & Polish). Per docs/MAGIC_PUBLISH_ROADMAP.md: "Goal. Add emotion. Scope. Audio priority: narration, then ambient music, then silence." Closing card carries the story title plus "✨ Created in VihuPlanet", with an optional Story Companion cameo. Deliverables: audio mix, closing sequence, brand polish. Success criteria: "Magic Creation feels complete." Design source is docs/MAGIC_PUBLISH_ARCHITECTURE.md sections 5.5 (three sound tiers, the ambient bed being AudioManager's already-licensed Foundation loops needing "only a mixdown path into ReelComposer's existing audio destination") and 5.6 ("a closing card, never an overlay... Held for 2.5s, after the art, over a clean background. A child's page is never covered", with the companion cameo marked "Optional, and I think worth it").
task: Audio tier is chosen ONCE per STORY, not per page — that is "priority order" read literally. If ANY page carries narration the whole reel runs on the narration tier with NO ambient bed, so a quiet child's voice is never competed with; otherwise the bed plays under the whole reel; otherwise silence. Narration attaches to the FIRST frame of its page so the voice runs under that page's whole assembly, and any shortfall between the clip and the page's own hold is added to the LAST frame — the finished picture is the right thing to look at while a sentence lands, and the reveal's own pacing is never stretched. Transition time is deliberately not counted, which only makes a page slightly longer: the safe direction. ReelComposer gains opts.ambientBuffer/opts.ambientGain (default AMBIENT_GAIN 0.22, exported): a looping BufferSource through a GainNode into the existing audioDest, started with the recording and torn down alongside the silence node — stopSilence became stopAudio so one teardown covers both and cannot drift out of sync with rec.onstop/rec.onerror. Absent ambientBuffer nothing allocates, so every existing caller is byte-identical. Only ONE Foundation loop is used rather than a mix: FOUNDATION_LAYERS' volumes are tuned for an always-on composite (magic.mp3 sits at literally 0), so they say nothing about solo use; harmony.mp3 was chosen by name — music rather than environmental texture (air/wind/forest) or effect (magic) — and is disclosed as unlistened, one constant to change. The closing card is one extra frame appended in finish(): 2500ms, wash rather than page-turn (it is not a page), tagged __magicOwned so the pre-existing release() frees it, painted on the film palette magicStrip.js already uses (#1E1A17 / #FFCB45) so both halves of Magic Publish close on one look. The companion portrait is contain-fit and never circle-clipped — a character sprite has transparent margins and cropping would cut its head off — and a Traveller simply gets the card without one: no gate, no prompt, no missing-asset gap. js/publishStudio.js needed NO changes: _renderNextPage already awaits a thenable from encodePage (added for Story Reel), so the synchronous Book/Carousel path stays byte-identical. renderer/slideRenderer.js is not touched either, so Museum Gallery's canonical hashes are not the gate for this ship. A script-relative _assetURL helper resolves the loop against this script's own location rather than the page's, the same fix js/audioManager.js and js/themeRepositoryClient.js already carry. Verified 38/38 via magic_m7_verify across seven sections: the bed genuinely wired (spies on AudioContext.prototype.createBufferSource/createGain prove exactly one source carries OUR buffer, loops, and runs through a GainNode at the exact level asked for, and that no bed means zero gains and zero bed-carrying sources); a real 9s WAV decoding onto frame 0 only, the page lasting at least clip+tail, and the shortfall landing on the LAST frame; a spy on ReelComposer.compose proving a silent story gets ambientBuffer and a voiced story does not; the card appended exactly once at 2500ms with wash, tagged, full-size, film-dark, carrying real gold brand pixels, and released to 0x0 after filming; a Traveller never asked for a companion and getting 0 magenta pixels while a Creator is asked once for their own bonded companion and yields >5000; and a real publish through the actual UI reaching Celebration with EBML magic read off the blob itself. Three test-methodology bugs were found and fixed in the suite, none of them app bugs: A8's >5000-byte floor was calibrated against real-content reels and a silent 3-frame flat-colour 120x200 clip is legitimately 1597 bytes, so it now reads the container magic off the blob instead; the synthetic companion portrait was #E91E63, whose blue channel is 99 and so could never match the suite's own r>200/g<60/b>150 magenta detector, corrected to #FF00FF; and section F used .publish-dest-card/.publish-format-card/.publish-dest-continue when the real classes are .publish-destination-card/.publish-destination-format/.publish-destination-continue.
